# Skill

Optimize Robot Code

## Purpose

Make tests faster without making them harder to trust.

## Inspect

- Current suite duration
- Slow keywords
- Browser startup time
- Page wait time

## Check

- Test independence
- Failure evidence
- Timeout changes
- Retry settings
- Repeated setup

## Process

1. Measure the current run.
2. Confirm the problem repeats.
3. Make one small improvement.
4. Run focused tests.
5. Run the full selected suite.

## Output

- Before duration
- After duration
- Files changed
- Test results
- Any tradeoff
